title: Why Is Yawning CONTAGIOUS? 🥱
description:
You see someone yawn... and suddenly you're yawning too. About half of adults catch yawns just from seeing one, and nobody is completely sure why. One idea: yawning helps cool the brain. In one study, people holding a cold pack to their forehead caught far fewer yawns. Another idea: it's social, because we copy the faces around us, and some dogs even catch human yawns. Weirdest of all, just reading about yawning can set one off. Subscribe for a new strange question every day.
